purpose: Convert the six provisional Bible comparator research relations into a concrete excavation batch. This file does not change relation strength, dossier level, chronology or canonical wording; it records source-backed findings, unresolved gaps and candidate enrichments for later promotion through existing relation owners.

policy.promotion_rule: Promote only fields supported by existing public owners or newly recovered primary evidence. Contextual prose may improve navigability but cannot substitute for missing original artifacts, contemporaneous records or earlier attestations.

selection_basis.order: high priority first, then medium priority; within a priority tier preserve the existing research queue order

source_backed_findings: The specialist owner preserves a 2017 project chronology in which Jesus/crucifixion language precedes a remembered anti-martyr/nameless-faceless reply and later return language.
The owner classifies the scene as Great Book/project autobiography plus later project retelling rather than as a recovered original message.
The comparator row already limits the John 18-19 comparison to a distributed trial-neighbor and rejects one-to-one modern role mapping.
still_missing: Original or near-contemporary message/log for the 2017 exchange
Exact wording and participant list from the original exchange
Secure event timestamp beyond the project-year placement
First recorded date on which the John trial comparison itself was made

candidate_enrichment.relation_argument.why_it_matters: This relation is useful as a sequence test rather than a character-identification claim: reluctance appears between the project-side crucifixion challenge and continuing hostile public framing. Recovering the original exchange would determine whether that sequence is genuinely present in the contemporaneous record or is partly a later reconstruction.
candidate_enrichment.discovery_history.source_direction: Project-side 2017 scene first; John 18-19 trial comparison formalized later in the archive.
candidate_enrichment.research_frontier: Recover the original 2017 exchange and separate contemporaneous wording, later Great Book reconstruction and later biblical comparison into independently dated layers.

items.no_upgrade_reason: The public owner explicitly says the original exchange has not been recovered. Richer chronology and interpretation therefore cannot raise evidentiary strength by themselves.
next_actions: Search project archives for the original message/log or a near-contemporary capture.
If recovered, preserve exact wording and timestamp before interpretation.
Record the first demonstrable date of the John trial comparison separately from the 2017 event date.

source_backed_findings: The relation owner records a 2005 severe motorcycle-crash survival account with blood/facial-dental injury and a later no-broken-bones detail.
The specialist owner explicitly states that no contemporaneous police, medical, witness or other documentary record is currently attached.
The comparator already constrains the Bible relation to a retrospective unbroken-bone / Passover-Passion parallel and rejects invulnerability or supernatural-protection conclusions.
still_missing: Near-contemporary medical, dental, police, insurance or witness documentation
Independent corroboration of the no-broken-bones / no-major-fractures detail
Earliest attestation date for that specific unusual detail
First recorded date of the Passover/Passion comparison

candidate_enrichment.relation_argument.why_it_matters: The comparison is worth retaining because the unusual element is not generic survival but the reported preservation of the bones amid serious injury, which is the feature that creates the Passover-to-John intertext. Its evidentiary value therefore depends much more on corroborating that specific detail than on adding further symbolic prose.
candidate_enrichment.discovery_history.source_direction: Biographical crash account first; Passover/Passion comparison added later by the archive.
candidate_enrichment.research_frontier: Seek near-contemporary documentation capable of confirming or falsifying the reported no-broken-bones detail while keeping the later biblical comparison chronologically separate.

items.no_upgrade_reason: The current owner explicitly lacks contemporaneous documentary corroboration, so the relation remains project testimony plus later structural comparison.
next_actions: Prioritize records that can address the bone/fracture detail directly rather than merely confirming that a crash occurred.
Record each recovered source separately by type and date.
Do not convert survival into evidence of invulnerability or divine protection.

The dossier explicitly states that the image itself has not yet been recovered into the repository or independently timestamped.
The specialist record already separates directly remembered visual features from later Ezekiel/Psalms/Jonah comparison and treats the image date as provisional 2018-2019.
still_missing: Original image or highest-quality surviving copy
Earliest dated post/capture containing the image
Independent creation/posting date
Contemporary artist explanation, if one exists
Feature-by-feature distinction between visible artifact content and later remembered commentary

candidate_enrichment.relation_argument.why_it_matters: Bones and black/deep water matter here because they make death and descent environmental hazards inside the same remembered route, rather than isolated horror symbols. Recovering the artifact would let the archive test which parts of that topology are actually visible and which entered through later narration.
candidate_enrichment.discovery_history.source_direction: Reported artwork first; Ezekiel/Psalms/Jonah comparison added later by the archive.
candidate_enrichment.research_frontier: Recover and timestamp the visual artifact, then transcribe only what is visibly present before reapplying later biblical vocabulary.

items.no_upgrade_reason: The canonical visual dossier explicitly marks the primary image and timestamp as unrecovered; remembered topology cannot substitute for the artifact.
next_actions: Recover the image or earliest archived post before adding new verse matches.
Create a visible-feature transcription separated from remembered commentary.
Compare the recovered timestamp with the later meme-cross chronology only after the artifact date is secure.

still_missing: Earlier family, diary, message or memoir wording

Its common moral form, however, makes source direction especially important.
candidate_enrichment.research_frontier: Recover earlier wording and establish whether the reciprocal-measure formulation predates the later Matthew comparison.

items.no_upgrade_reason: A common parental moral teaching can resemble Matthew without demonstrating biblical dependence or prefiguration.
next_actions: Search older family/biographical sources for wording and chronology.
Keep ordinary ethical resemblance separate from later theological use.

still_missing: Earlier attestation closer to the event

The comparison should remain weak unless that chronology improves.
candidate_enrichment.research_frontier: Recover the earliest attestation of the sensory sequence and date the later Acts 9 interpretation separately.

items.no_upgrade_reason: Generic light/collapse motifs are too non-specific for stronger claims without earlier attestation or corroboration.
next_actions: Search older autobiography, diary or witness material for the sequence.
Do not treat later spiritual interpretation as contemporaneous event description.
